decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are still an uncertain but low-cost option with a dedicated page, so the option value outweighs carrying cost.
PETG thermoforming blank is a low-cost consumable with its own page, and its market potential is still resolving, so it is worth keeping as an option.
UV-curing lacquer is mentioned only, but its low carrying cost and possible role in digital finishing keep the option alive while uncertainty remains.
Intraoral contrast spray directly supports digital scanning workflows and has its own page, making it a strategically valuable option with low drop probability.
Custom earmold product line aligns with the firm's core custom manufacturing and is still at an early stage, so the option is worth maintaining.
Custom hearing protection earmolds are adjacent to the earmold line and hold option value, though slightly higher uncertainty due to only being mentioned.
